integrity.computation: Standalone stdlib Python checker, 60 exact finite witness cases, verification output recorded.
integrity.external_validation: No independent audit or expert validation performed.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit permutation-group generation plus DFA reachability/distinguishability and right-quotient final-set analysis; established unary-range theorem cited for low targets.

scientific_limitations: The new theorem fixes alphabet size two and the accepting-state complexity spectrum, not a state-minimal construction or an optimal-size pair of automata. The low-target portion invokes a published unary result; unindexed equivalent binary constructions remain possible.
title: Binary alphabet suffices for every positive right-quotient accepting-state complexity of permutation languages
